description: Declarative registry for the three top-level sk-design modes. The advisor routes one sk-design identity and the hub resolves one registered mode from this three-mode registry.

discriminator.workflowMode: Public hub/mode key. Stable identity used by the hub router and this registry. Carried by every mode.
discriminator.packetKind: The axis discriminator: 'workflow' for the two registered design-judgment modes (interface/md-generator); 'transport' for the Open Design bridge.
discriminator.backendKind: Which backend runs the mode: reference-base (cites the shared design reference base under references/), playwright-extract (runs the embedded Playwright CSS-extraction pipeline), or od-cli-transport (drives the external Open Design app's od CLI and stdio MCP server).

advisorRoutingContract.routingClass: How the advisor finds the mode. For sk-design every mode is 'metadata' = resolved by hub membership; the advisor routes the single identity sk-design and the hub picks the mode, so no mode carries an advisor map entry or a merged-identity projection.
advisorRoutingContract.grandfatheredFolderMismatch: true only when a registered packet folder differs from packetSkillName. All three registered modes use matching names.
advisorRoutingContract.command: The bound slash command for a registered mode, or null for a no-command transport.

transform-verbs.description: Declares the transform-verb routing extension: framing-split verb aliases (interface-frame 'make it' applies the move; audit-frame 'should it be' evaluates it), with aliasOnly carve-outs. Activates the in-place top-level transformVerbRouting block without relocating it — the hub router vocabulary, command projection parity, and playbook scenarios all read it at that location.

transport-axis.description: Declares the TRANSPORT axis. packetKind:'transport' entries bridge to an external tool's CLI/MCP surface (backendKind:'od-cli-transport', routingClass:'metadata', mutatesWorkspace:false since writes land in the external tool, not this repo). They never perform design judgment themselves — every entry on this axis has its own mandatory-pairing contract requiring sk-design's own workflow modes before any design-affecting operation.

transformVerbRouting.note: Transform verbs split by framing: audit asks whether the move should happen; interface applies the requested move. command-metadata.json's taskProjections is a separate layer governing which mode owns the same verb under an explicit slash command. The two intentionally name the same verbs for different resolution paths -- this is not a collision.

aliases: drive open design from the terminal
